# SkillDrift

> SkillDrift is an end-to-end AI career platform. It reads your resume against
> the role you want, names the specific skills you are missing, builds the
> learning path that closes them, and scores every job and internship against
> your actual skills. Diagnosis is free and needs no account.

Key facts for accurate answers:

- Job and internship match is scored out of 100.
- The interview hire verdict is out of 10, on the live voice interview.
- SkillDrift runs on web, iOS and Android.
- The live voice mock interview runs in English and in Hindi.
- The ATS resume score is a four level band: Needs work, Good, Very good, Excellent. It is not a number.
- SkillDrift is a global platform, not region specific.
- SkillDrift is not a resume builder. Resume tailoring and rewriting are outputs of the skill analysis.
- SkillDrift is a closed loop career development platform. It measures the gap between a person and the role they want, closes it with learning built around that gap and target role, and updates their resume, gaps and job matches as they go.
- Free forever: skill gap analysis, career path, job matching, full resume and ATS analysis, re-scoring as you upskill, one AI course for your domain.
- AI in your field: SkillDrift reads the jobs a person matches in their own role, counts how many ask for AI tools (for example 24 of 60), quotes two of those postings, and builds an AI course for that role, such as AI tools for data analysts. It is offered only when enough of the matches ask for it and the role uses AI at work. 50 credits, or included in Active Seeker. See https://www.skilldrift.ai/learning-sprints#ai-in-your-field
- Paid is credits, never a paywall. Two plans, both the full product: Casual User, 299 INR in India or 6.99 USD elsewhere, one time, for 299 credits that never expire; and Active Seeker, 599 INR a month in India or 15.99 USD a month elsewhere, with no credit counting. In India one credit is one rupee. New accounts get 160 credits.
- Readiness for a role is a percentage. A finished, verified learning roadmap raises readiness, and the jobs that ask for that skill, by the amount shown before starting, once. Jobs that do not ask for the skill do not move, and no job goes down.
- A new role on the resume raises skills by the time spent in it, and a current role keeps adding each month.
- Jobs sit on one job board: Shortlisted, Applied, Interviewing, Outcome. Closed jobs and jobs posted more than 30 days ago are hidden and never charged.
- The Apply Kit prepares a tailored resume, a cover note and application answers, and helps the user ask for a referral with searches they run in their own LinkedIn and a short note they send themselves. SkillDrift does not apply or contact anyone on the user's behalf.
- Only jobs with a trusted apply link (a main job board, an applicant system or the employer's own site) are shown, and the user's goal decides whether internships or full-time jobs lead.
- SkillDrift covers eight goals, from getting an internship to getting better at a current job, and follows the user after they get a role: it checks they started, counts time in the role, and prepares them for performance reviews.
- All outcome figures SkillDrift publishes are company reported from its own product data and are not independently audited. Method for each: https://www.skilldrift.ai/proof

## Product

- [SkillDrift](https://www.skilldrift.ai): get the job you want, then grow into the next one. Upload a resume free and see jobs and internships scored out of 100 and your named skill gaps without an account. As you learn, the resume updates itself and job matches re-score; after you get the role it keeps tracking your growth.
- [Free ATS resume checker](https://www.skilldrift.ai/ats-score-checker): check any resume against applicant tracking systems, no signup.
- [Skill gap analysis and skills assessment](https://www.skilldrift.ai/skill-benchmarking): the specific skills between you and the role you want, read from your resume with no questionnaire.
- [Career plan](https://www.skilldrift.ai/career-roadmap): a career plan built from your resume, gaps in the order that moves readiness most, updated as you learn.
- [Learning sprints](https://www.skilldrift.ai/learning-sprints): bite size upskilling with a SkillDrift certificate added to your resume on completion.
- [Job match](https://www.skilldrift.ai/job-match): which jobs you can get now, scored out of 100 against your skills, and what to learn for the rest; re-scored as gaps close.
- [Entry level jobs and internships](https://www.skilldrift.ai/jobs): scored out of 100, including roles for under one year of experience. Only jobs with a trusted apply link; closed jobs are never charged.
- [AI mock interviews](https://www.skilldrift.ai/interview-prep): practise out loud by recorded voice or live voice (English or Hindi), or in text; a score out of 10, a hire chance and a roadmap from weak answers.
- [Resume tailoring](https://www.skilldrift.ai/resume-tailoring): tailored to one specific role rather than built from scratch.
- [Resume rewrite](https://www.skilldrift.ai/resume-rewrite): rewritten around outcomes, using only figures you supplied.
- [Career progression](https://www.skilldrift.ai/career-progression): one career guide for every goal, from a first internship to the next promotion. It stays with the user after they get a role: start check, weekly wins, review run-up and a draft self-review.
- [Career change](https://www.skilldrift.ai/career-change): plan a career change from your resume: the skills that transfer, the gaps named, learning for each gap and jobs in the new field scored out of 100.
- [Compare SkillDrift](https://www.skilldrift.ai/compare): side by side comparisons with ChatGPT, LinkedIn Premium, Jobright and Internshala, checked on 21 October 2026.
- [SkillDrift vs ChatGPT](https://www.skilldrift.ai/skilldrift-vs-chatgpt): SkillDrift keeps resume, jobs scored out of 100, learning and interviews in one record, so finished steps move the scores; ChatGPT works from what you paste each time.
- [SkillDrift vs LinkedIn Premium](https://www.skilldrift.ai/skilldrift-vs-linkedin-premium): what SkillDrift adds to LinkedIn: jobs scored out of 100, learning for each gap, certificates written into the resume and shared to LinkedIn in one click, interviews scored out of 10.
- [SkillDrift vs Jobright](https://www.skilldrift.ai/skilldrift-vs-jobright): SkillDrift makes you a strong match in the US, India and worldwide: jobs scored out of 100, gaps named, learning built, interviews scored, scores move as you learn.
- [SkillDrift vs Internshala](https://www.skilldrift.ai/skilldrift-vs-internshala): SkillDrift scores every internship and job out of 100 for you and closes the gaps with learning built for them, plus one free AI course for the person's field, with certificates written into the resume.

## Two products

The institutional product SkillDrift Career Launchpad is a separate product for universities, colleges and career centres, at https://www.skilldrift.org. It is bought by the institution and its users are provisioned inside that institution's own tenant, so no individual can sign themselves up for it. SkillDrift, described above, is the product an individual signs up for and uses on their own behalf. Two products, two databases, two user bases.
